About GreenJobs
GreenJobs is a job board wholly dedicated to recruitment in the green industry sector.
Launched in 2008, the GreenJobs website specifically targets candidates across all areas of the environmental and renewable energy market place.
GreenJobs covers a wide variety of job types including – alternative energy jobs, biofuel jobs, biomass jobs, carbon jobs, conservation jobs, ecology jobs, energy efficiency jobs, environmental jobs, environment jobs, green jobs, hydro jobs, hydropower jobs, marine jobs, offshore wind jobs, renewable energy jobs, solar jobs, sustainability jobs, tidal jobs, waste jobs, wastewater jobs, water jobs and wind jobs.
GreenJobs attracts thousands of visitors to its website every month.
GreenJobs is a user-friendly website offering both registered candidates and employers a highly flexible and easy to use interface.
GreenJobs is a member of The GreenJobs Network of Websites that includes:

- EcologyJobs
- EnvironmentalJobs

Talent Attraction Solutions
Advertising That Works For You
With a variety of advertising options and tailored solutions, advertising on GreenJobs is a cost effective way of attracting high-calibre candidates to apply for your vacancies. The core services that we offer are as follows:
Standard Job Posting – What’s Included
Each job posting includes your full job description and logo and is live for up to 6 weeks
The GreenJobs Network of Websites – Each job posting is displayed on all relevant websites in our network (Displayed below) depending on the exact job description at no additional cost for up to 6 Weeks.
Weekly Jobs Newsletter – Each job posting is displayed prominently in one weekly jobs newsletter
Job Alerts by Email – Information about your Job posting will automatically be emailed to candidates who have requested to be informed about this type of career opportunity for up to 6 Weeks
Company Profile – This is a description about your organisation which includes your logo, full contact details and current vacancies listed underneath and it is displayed for up to 6 Weeks
Talent Finder Network - Each job posting is displayed on our Talent Finder Network for up to 6 Weeks.
Social Media Network - Each job posting is displayed on our Social Media Network for up to 6 Weeks
Premium Job Posting - What's Included
With the premium job posting you get everything that is included with the standard job posting plus the following.
Featured Job – Each job posting is prominently displayed at the top of the appropriate job results pages (i.e. Job type pages, industry sector pages, Job Category pages, Job location pages etc.) on all relevant websites in our network for up to 6 Weeks
Job Alerts by Email Sponsorship – In this email your Organisations logo will be prominently displayed for up to 6 Weeks and when a candidate clicks on your logo they will be redirected to your job on our website
Job Posting Packages/Memberships
Discounted rates are available for multiple job postings and annual memberships.
Traffic Drivers/Employer Branding Opportunities
Traffic drivers and employer branding opportunities are the perfect solution for you to drive more applications to your job vacancies. In the war for talent it is increasingly important for organisations to clearly communicate their employee brand proposition and to state what their brand stands for and why job seekers should want to work for your organisation.
Featured Job
For maximum exposure a featured job slot which is prominently displayed at the top of the job results page, job category page, job location page and job type page is the perfect opportunity for you to increase your brand profile and response levels.
Featured Employer (Home Page & Run of Site)
This is an opportunity for you to showcase your employer brand on the home screen and other prominent pages and drive more candidates to your job postings. In a competitive recruitment environment where attracting the best talent is crucial to an organisation's success this ensures potential employees are aware that you are currently recruiting.
Job included in Weekly Jobs Newsletter
A weekly jobs newsletter is emailed to our registered candidates and your job posting will be prominently displayed in this.
Banner Advertising (Home Page & Run of Site)
Prominently displayed at the top of the home page and other prominent pages this is an excellent method for you to build your employer brand proposition and drive traffic to your job postings.
Job Alerts by Email Sponsorship
This is a great method to communicate with the hard to reach passive jobseekers who are looking for their next exciting career move. In the email that they receive your organisations logo will be prominently displayed and when they click on your logo they will be redirected to your jobs on our various websites.
Banner Advertising - Job Results Pages
Prominently displayed near the top of the job results page for particular industry sectors, job categories and locations this is an excellent method to target candidates with a particular expertise.
Weekly Jobs Newsletter Sponsorship (Including Job of the week)
A weekly jobs newsletter is emailed to our registered candidates and your sponsorship is prominently displayed at the top of this newsletter thus ensuring that your employer brand proposition and job vacancies are effectively communicated to potential candidates. This also includes one of your job postings as job of the week.
Company Profile
This is a description about your organisation which includes your logo, full contact details and current vacancies listed underneath.
Bespoke Branded Email Campaign
A bespoke branded email campaign is an email that is sent out to candidates that have registered to receive this type of communication and only contains information about your organisation such as your current job opportunities. The content of this email can be tailored to your exact requirements.

/one-percent-for-the-planet-member.cms.a.text:
THE GREENJOBS NETWORK OF WEBSITES - 1% FOR THE PLANET - MEMBER
In keeping with our commitment to the environment, The GreenJobs Network of Websites is a proud member of 1% for the Planet .
This means that we donate at least 1% of our Annual Turnover to environmental organisations in Ireland and the United Kingdom.
ABOUT 1% FOR THE PLANET
1% for the Planet is a global organization that connects dollars and doers to accelerate smart environmental giving. We recognize that the current level of environmental giving—only 3% of total philanthropy—is not enough to solve the most pressing issues facing our planet.
1% for the Planet inspires people to support environmental organizations through annual membership and everyday actions. We advise on giving strategies, we certify donations and we amplify the impact of our network. The idea is simple: because companies profit from the resources they take from the earth, they should protect those resources.
Started in 2002 by Yvon Chouinard, founder of Patagonia, and Craig Mathews, founder of Blue Ribbon Flies, our members have given more than $265 million to environmental nonprofits to date. Today, 1% for the Planet is a network of more than 3,400 business members, a new and expanding core of individual members and thousands of nonprofit partners in more than 91 countries. We connect our members with high-impact nonprofit partners in our six core issue areas: climate, food, land, pollution, water and wildlife.
Our headquarters are located in Burlington, VT with staff located around the world.
Our Vision
All together for the planet.
Our Mission
We bring dollars and doers together to accelerate smart environmental giving.
Our Model
1% for the Planet is a global movement inspiring businesses and individuals to support environmental solutions through annual membership and everyday actions. We advise on giving strategies, we certify donations and we amplify the impact of our network.
Our Core Values
• Unleash passion every day
• Celebrate commitment
• Grow stronger together
• Think big, act now
To Learn more about 1% for the Planet and how you can support them check out - www.onepercentfortheplanet.org

/cv-writing-service.cms.asp.title: CV Writing Service
/cv-writing-service.cms.asp.text:
CV Writing Service
Jobs in the green sector generally continue to be resilient, whilst this makes for an attractive environment in which to work, it also means the competition for jobs gets tougher and tougher.
Your CV is often the first and only chance to make an impression. Yet with upwards of 50 applications for most jobs, and recruiter’s spending less than 30 seconds reading each CV, how well is yours standing out?
There are many talented professionals in our industry who have achieved fantastic results as part of their job – yet when it comes to their CV, sell themselves short. People often tend to fall back on tired recruitment clichés such as ‘dynamic’ or ‘forward thinking’ (that could apply to almost anyone) or simply don’t market themselves well at all.
Think of your CV as a personal sales brochure. You only have the briefest opportunity to attract a buyer. So when the eyes of the recruiter meet your CV it needs to have immediate impact. You must really sell yourself. And, importantly, back up what you say. This may be one the trickiest aspects of writing your own CV. It doesn’t feel natural for many people to highlight their own achievements let alone ‘sell’ themselves.
The first thing to do is to write an original statement about your individual qualities in the ‘Professional Profile’. Keep it short - 4 or 5 lines should do it - but try to make it different. In the ‘Career History’ section focus on your achievements. Too many job seekers write in great detail about their responsibilities forgetting the focus needs to be on results.
Recruiters love facts and figures. They’re indisputable. They place a real value on what you’ve achieved. It’s fine to write about team achievements too. Numbers, percentages, fractions, time scales: facts and figures stick in the minds of recruiters not job descriptions.
If you are not getting the interviews you should then perhaps it’s time re-visit your CV? When you think of how important a CV is in terms of your future career prospects perhaps it’s not surprising that more and more job seekers are turning to professional CV writers for help.
Need help with your CV?
If you’d like help with your CV then we have teamed up with leading CV writing specialists CV Writers who provide a professional writing service and free CV review .
